power-rank.formal_scope: The main and arbitrary-rank companion theorems are formalized. Generating-function and polynomial corollaries retain conventional proofs.

admm-counterexample.formal_scope: Seven modules and eleven endpoint audits cover the orbit, minimizers and optimizer. Analytic regularity of the finite strongly convex extension retains a conventional proof.

graph-roots.formal_scope: All numbered manuscript conclusions are formalized in seventy modules with 258 endpoint audits. Historical novelty and exact external-source correspondence remain provisional.

motzkin-bounded-forcing.formal_scope: The arbitrary-real recurrence theorem and scaled corollary, including zero forcing, are formalized. Concrete sequences, uniform-family applications, root transfer and threshold classification retain conventional proofs.

sidon-renyi.formal_scope: The finite-support iid theorem, zero probabilities and critical endpoint are formalized. Comparison with unverified source definitions is conditional.

ordered-allocation.formal_scope: The transfer theorem is formalized. Existence of a fair allocation before transfer is outside the result; external source comparison is provisional.

kunisky.formal_scope: The internally defined resolution-tree functional and proof class are formalized. No unconditional identification with an external conjecture or a regular proof class is claimed.

pure-ecqc.formal_scope: The dimension-five identical-local-basis theorem is formalized. The prime-family extension is conventional; arbitrary or independently optimized basis choices are outside the result.

kovacec.formal_scope: Actual normal matrices, determinants, straight-segment exterior and component exclusion are formalized. Correspondence with an external source conjecture is conditional.

leaf-deletion.formal_scope: The fixed tree, deletion, actual domination counts and unique-mode movement are formalized. External question identity and historical priority remain provisional.

steering-bounds.formal_scope: Actual two-qubit density matrices, canonical filters, Pauli correlations, the exact least upper bound, attainment and nonattainment, and fully entangled fraction are formalized. The steering-ellipsoid and optimized CJWR measurement interpretations use cited external correspondences; general steerability is outside the result.

strong-gradient.formal_scope: The actual-function upper bound and normalized actual-function attainment are formalized, including every horizon and closed parameter boundary. Sharpness for arbitrary L > 0 and radius R > 0 is proved by rescaling in the manuscript, without a separate Lean wrapper.

unicyclic-skewness.formal_scope: The interval for actual tilted-matrix derivatives and a local branch is formalized. Identification with long-time stochastic cumulants and sharpness have conventional proofs. Lean does not construct a continuous-time sample-path probability space or a separate optimizing-sequence theorem.

projection-amgm.formal_scope: Lean verifies a rational three-projection matrix obstruction and a parameterized obstruction for every real multiplier in dimension three; rank-one, positive-definite mean, rational all-multiplier choices, and the standard minimal-factor observation have complete conventional proofs.

fidelity-three-state.formal_scope: The unrestricted three-state ensemble theorem is formalized for actual positive semidefinite complex matrices of trace one, nonnegative weights summing to one, spectral entropy and nuclear-norm root fidelity. Credited QICLean foundations and prior-work adapters retain their attribution.

quantum-exact-contraction.formal_scope: The exact conditional hockey-stick contraction coefficients are formalized for actual finite-reference density states, every stochastic Pauli qubit channel, the full physical signed depolarizing family in every dimension d ≥ 2, and every γ ≥ 1. Channel constructors, unrestricted upper bounds and matching supremum witnesses are included. Unital-qubit normal-form existence is cited; erasure-simulation and ensemble-guessing consequences retain conventional proofs.

nesterov-subcritical.formal_scope: The continuous-time Hilbert-space threshold, the discrete threshold and the planar escape for 1 < r ≤ 2, including actual gradients, global solutions from rest and norm divergence, are formalized. The planar escape of the same potential for 0 < r ≤ 1, its boundedness for r > 2 and existence of solutions for r ≤ 1 are conventional.

chambolle-pock-cycles.formal_scope: The universal three-cycle threshold and its attainment, the seven-cycle with its open basin, the four-dimensional family for every κ > 2 and the quadratic eigenmode comparison are formalized in 21 Lean modules. The limsup consequence, numerical observations of larger θ-intervals and basin sizes, and the finite-dimensional matrix-convergence bridge are conventional or observational.

critical-hardcore.formal_scope: The influence bound for the actual hard-core Gibbs measure on every finite simple graph of maximum degree at most Δ, all activities up to λ_c(Δ) and all feasible pinnings is formalized in 32 Lean modules, including the regular completion and the nonbacktracking collision estimate. The Glauber-dynamics mixing corollary and the numerical observations on the constant are not formalized.

upb-tensor-rank.formal_scope: The rank-doubling theorem with an arbitrary partner, strong minimum-rank multiplicativity, the Tiles support and normalized density operators, and the exact all-copy Schmidt-number equivalence are formalized in 22 Lean modules. The zero-error LOCC cost, the rank-four two-qutrit PPT class and the channel interpretation combine the formal theorem with published results.

binary-spectral-tile.formal_scope: Spectrality with an actual basis of all complex functions on E, the tiling E ⊕ T = F₂⁹, aperiodicity of E, the exclusion of every periodic and every subspace complement, the classification of all complements as the 512 translates of T, and the failure of the periodic tiling property for F₂⁹ are formalized in 16 Lean modules. Minimality of dimension nine depends on an external dimension-eight theorem and is not formalized.
